description: The company's notice of the shares it bought back, filed through the London Stock Exchange news service. Since February 2026 one notice may cover a week. Its table lists each exchange the shares were bought on.
takes: Date, shares, highest and lowest price, average price, exchange, broker if named, treatment wording (cancelled or held in treasury), running total when stated

form: Statement re share buyback / Share Buyback Programme
description: The company announces a new buyback programme: its size, start and end, the broker and what happens to the shares.
takes: Announcement date, size, start and end wording, broker, treatment wording

description: Tells the market how many shares are in issue and carry votes after shares are cancelled or held in treasury.
takes: Not read by the tool

form: Change to, or end of, a programme
description: A notice that extends, enlarges, ends or completes a programme.
takes: Read as a programme update only when it states the new size or dates; completion letters are classed but hold no figures

description: The company announces a buy-back: type, size, dates, the maximum shares or amount, and the broker.
takes: Buy-back type, maximum shares or amount, start and end, broker, shares on issue

description: Filed before trading on the next business day. States the shares bought the previous day, the price range and the running total.
takes: Date, shares, consideration, highest and lowest price, running total before and on the day

description: Changes the size, price limit or end of a buy-back already announced.
takes: New size or dates, with the form's own field names

description: Closes the buy-back and states the totals.
takes: Total shares and total consideration

description: Reports securities that have ceased, including shares cancelled after a buy-back.
takes: Security, number ceased, reason, date, consideration

description: The form for buy-backs announced before 5 June 2021: each item shows the terms as announced (Column 1) and the change (Column 2). The two columns run together in the filing's text, so a change is taken only where it can be told apart.
takes: A new period (start and end) or maximum number, where both columns are dated or numbered; the reason for the change. Any other change goes to review with its wording

description: The daily notice for buy-backs announced before 5 June 2021. States the shares and amount before the previous day and on it. The form gives no date for the previous day, only the date it was signed.
takes: Shares and amount on the previous day, dated the trading day before the notice (Calculated); running total before it; highest and lowest price; date the Appendix 3C was given; shares remaining

description: Closes a buy-back announced before 5 June 2021 and states the totals.
takes: Total shares and total consideration, the programme marked Completed. A scanned 3F has no text and cannot be read

description: Securities issued, transferred or converted, for example when employee rights vest. Not a buy-back form: kept apart and never netted against purchases.
takes: Each issue: class, number, date, class converted from, whether new securities were issued or existing ones transferred, the company's wording; securities on issue afterwards

form: Notice in the company's own words
description: A buy-back notice that is not on the ASX form.
takes: Read by pattern; anything unclear goes to review

description: The company announces an on-market buyback under its NZX listing rules.
takes: Read by pattern from the wording

description: The same form as on ASX, used by some New Zealand companies.
takes: As for ASX

description: Reports a change in the shares on issue, including shares bought back and cancelled.
takes: Number of shares acquired or cancelled, date, consideration

description: As on ASX.
takes: As for ASX

description: A fixed form every SGX-listed company files after a day's buying: the purchase, the price range, the amount paid, the running total since the mandate, and shares in issue and in treasury afterwards.
takes: Date, shares, highest and lowest price, total consideration, shares cancelled and held in treasury, mandate start and size, running total

form: Off-market purchase on an equal access scheme
description: A buyback offered to all shareholders on equal terms.
takes: Not read by the tool

form: Other SGX announcements about a buyback
description: Mandate approvals and renewals, and other announcements.
takes: Not read by the tool

description: HKEX's daily list of every company that bought shares, one row per company, day and exchange. Read from an Excel file given by link.
takes: Date, shares, highest and lowest price, aggregate price, exchange, shares for cancellation and for treasury, the mandate's running count

description: A company's own return the day after a change in its shares. Section I shows balances and events, I B lists shares bought but not yet cancelled, II the repurchase report with the mandate, III sales of treasury shares.
takes: Purchases by day, exchange and currency, shares for cancellation and treasury, mandate date and size and amount used, cancellation events, balances

description: The month's movements in issued and treasury shares. States dates and counts but no price or exchange.
takes: Counts only: repurchase events and the month's balances. Never added to purchases, so a day already reported is not counted twice

filing_type: Share issue or sale of treasury shares
description: A return that reports only share issues, option exercises or a sale of treasury shares.
takes: Left out: it holds no buyback

form: Company announcement of a buyback (circular, explanatory statement)
description: Shareholder circular and explanatory statement for a repurchase mandate.
takes: Not read by the tool
